{{Quote|I only deal with officers. If you're planning to become a real officer someday, maybe you should wait until you're ready.|Ellis Arrison, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:OM1" />}}
'''Ellis Arrison''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Officer/Legends|military officer]] who lived on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. By the time of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Ellis Arrison resided in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] along with his brother [[Purvis Arrison|Purvis]].<ref name="SWG:OM1" />

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> Ellis Arrison undertook the supervision of a young [[Cadet/Legends|cadet]]<ref name="SWG:OM1" /> who had started officer training with [[Antom Moria]] on [[Tansarii Point Station/Legends|Tansarii Point Station]].<ref name="SWG:OA">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Officer|Officer Antom|Tansarii Point Station}}</ref> In order to train the cadet in leading soldiers into battle, Ellis ordered his trainee to attack the [[Krayt Cult Cave]] near Mos Eisley and kill a number of [[Krayt Cult]]ists. After the cadet returned successful from the mission,<ref name="SWG:OM1" /> Arrison sent him to continue his training under [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Eom Nia]] on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].<ref name="SWG:OM2">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Officer|Officer Mission 2|Naboo}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Ellis Arrison was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:OM1" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Ellis Arrison was added to the game upon the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]," a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref>
